name: Sharing Faith
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively share their faith by making disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, and preaching repentance and forgiveness of sins. Jesus emphasizes that He alone is the way to the Father, underscoring the exclusive truth of the gospel message that must be proclaimed to every creature. Believers are chosen and appointed by Christ to bear lasting spiritual fruit through this mission, empowered by prayer in His name.
